Instant Recharge uses special material to reduce the recharging time of Normal Recharge.
When you register a rechargeable item, the item's name will be displayed.
After registering the item for recharging, you should select a material item required for the recharge. Rechargeable durations are 1 day, 7 days, 15 days and 30 days.
Required quantity of materials can be different regarding to item type & recharge duration.
When you select the duration and click on Instant Recharge button, the item duration will be recharged immediately, material items will be consumed and recharged item will be useable again.
Please note that the duration of item will start running as soon as Instant Recharge is completed.

_910.TextB:
Normal Recharge is to keep an expired item for a while for recharging the duration to make it reusable again.
Normal Recharge has maximum 7 slots, basically 1 slot available at first and rest of the 6 slots can be unlocked with some fee.
When Normal Recharge slot is unlocked and empty, you can register item by right-clicking or drag&drop it from the bag inventory.
After registration, required time for full recharge, duration time after recharge and recharge fee will be displayed.
After registering the rechargeable item with possessing enough money for the fee, clicking the recharge button will start the recharging procedure.
When the recharge is completed, Tamer can retrieve and reuse the item by clicking withdraw button. Please note that the duration of item will start running as soon as it is returned to your inventory.
When you press Cancel button during recharge, you can stop the process. However, the fee that you paid when starting the recharge will not be refunded.
Due to the type of items, there are items that can be recharged and items that cannot be recharged. Same for both Normal Recharge and Instant Recharge.
